# Public Teams: What does the blue bar mean?

![](/uploads/ajaxGallery_58_nukaknights-post-blauer-balken.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

#### The blue bar for some team members represents the "**bond**" or loyalty to current players in the team.

After joining the team, the bar will be filled for **about 5 minutes** until it is full and the team will then receive an additional **bonus**. (time factor)

This means that the **Team Bonus** only becomes active when the blue bar is full, e.g. Intelligence bonus with a casual team.

You don't have this bar yourself because you can't build any "bonds" with yourself.

This “band” is saved as long as you are on a server. If you change teams on this server, your ties to the respective players will remain intact. Example: you are on a team with someone and then decide to open a new team with two people, then you will immediately have full ties again in the new team.

Another note: The number next to "St" in the "Public Teams" tab is the average of the levels of all current team members.
